title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Duo #14 (L:세로 띠·물결 / C:대각 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Turkish woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, demure and soft, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long almond nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 23% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 43% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following the contours of the body, dense repeating floral border filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder), wide gold-powder bands following the contours of the body, dense gold powder glittering densely filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Italian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, cool and composed, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 35% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, dense zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense folk-art florals filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), wide gold-leaf bands following the contours of the body, dense eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme ballet heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
